html:
Steve Jobs was the American businessman who co-founded Apple and led the making of products that brought computers and smartphones to ordinary people.

He started Apple in 1976 with his friend Steve Wozniak in the family garage in Los Altos, California. Wozniak was the engineer; Jobs was the one who pictured what people wanted and pushed for simple, beautiful design. The Apple II (1977) was one of the first successful home computers, and the Macintosh (1984) made the mouse and on screen windows popular.

In 1985 he was forced out of Apple. He then founded the computer company NeXT and bought the animation studio Pixar, which made Toy Story, the first fully computer animated feature film, in 1995.

Apple bought NeXT in 1997, and Jobs came back to save the company, then close to bankruptcy.

  • 1998: the iMac
  • 2001: the iPod, and soon the iTunes music store
  • 2007: the iPhone, which made the smartphone a mass product
  • 2010: the iPad

He died of pancreatic cancer in 2011. By then Apple was one of the most valuable companies in the world.
sum: Steve Jobs was the American businessman who co-founded Apple and led the making of products that brought computers and smartphones to ordinary people.
